name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=battle core table -> data_fd2_battle_). '12color' is a real domain dimension: the table has 12 entries indexed by color_idx 0..11 (matches the 12-slot frame-counter/color-idx arrays and the modulo-12 color rotation), not a Ghidra address residue. 'sprite_offset_table' reflects both the primary role (per-color base sprite-sheet index, additive to the frame counter) and the byte[12] array datatype. No hex suffix equal to its own or any data address. Secondary SFX-path-select use is a derived zero/nonzero test on the same value and is fully documented in the comment; it does not warrant a longer name.
purpose: Read-only per-color base sprite-sheet index for the 12-sprite main summon-spell (zhao huan xi) animation; the value also selects the SFX path (zero vs nonzero).
logic_summary: 12-byte const table, indexed by color_idx (0..11). Sole consumer fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state (@0x26795) copies the whole table into a stack local (3x MOVSD @0x267D0/0x267D5) then byte-reads it: (1) rendered sprite_id = per-slot frame_counter[i] + sprite_offset[color_idx]; (2) SFX gating -- if sprite_offset[color]!=0 a frame-0 'with-handle' chime plays (fd2_play_sfx_with_handle, sfx 2), if ==0 a frame-3 'sample-from-bank' chime plays (fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank, sfx 1). Values {0x16,0,0,0,0,0,0x0B,0,0x16,0,0,0}: colors 0,6,8 carry a nonzero sprite offset (and the with-handle chime path), the rest are zero (base sprite + sample-from-bank path).
element_semantics: Per-color (color_idx 0..11) unsigned base sprite-sheet index offset, byte-loaded with stride 1; nonzero also marks the color as a 'chime' color selecting the with-handle SFX path, zero selects the sample-from-bank path.
comment_original_issue: src comment was already accurate/clean. Ghidra side held the documentation in a deprecated PRE_COMMENT field (not PLATE_COMMENT) and contained non-ASCII chars (em-dash, identical-to, arrow, multiplication sign) plus process residue ('Boundary fix: Ghidra mis-split as undefined4x3 ... Siblings 0x524a0/0x524a4 absorbed').
